# FRAMEWORK-IMPROVEMENTS — suggestions for cap-evolve itself (cross-run)

NOT about this capability or this run's result — about what cap-evolve the FRAMEWORK should change so FUTURE runs (any capability, any project) go better: a confusing prompt section, a missing tool, a file you wished existed, a gate that felt wrong. Optional most iterations; add an entry whenever something about the framework itself (not the task) got in your way or surprised you.

## cand_0001
- The INSTRUCTIONS say "EMPTY SEED — the capability directory is EMPTY (create from scratch)", but the working dir already had a full `policy/policy.md`, `tools/tools.py`, and `reference/data_model.py`. That contradiction cost time verifying what to edit. Either detect a non-empty seed and drop the "empty" wording, or state "seed content present — edit it."
- The trajectory JSONs carry the decisive signal (`metadata.tau2_reward_info.reward_breakdown` = per-basis DB vs COMMUNICATE, and `communicate_checks` with the exact missing string) but the top-level `score.feedback` truncates it. Surfacing `reward_breakdown` + the missing communicate strings directly in the summary block would let an optimizer target COMMUNICATE-only vs DB-only failures without hand-parsing every trace.
- No pytest/verify harness was provided; I had to discover `venv-tau2-custom` and the runtime `db.json` path myself. A pointer to the exact python env + db path used at scoring time (so tool-body fixes can be unit-verified) would de-risk every tools iteration.
